authorized_scope: Allowlist-selected, transformed, and de-identified source results, only to the extent of rights held by the confirming project owner.
conditions: The source file is individually allowlisted.
The fixed-revision content matches the recorded SHA-256 digest.
The required transform and de-identification are completed before introduction.
Applicable third-party notices and license terms are preserved.
Any uncertainty about ownership, public distribution, or relicensing blocks that file.
